subject: Cross-region activation scenarios and verification plan
messages:
From: Laura Miles <security@meridianbank.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@meridianbank.com
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Meridian DR questionnaire - cross-region activation scenarios

Irene,

Thanks for taking our disaster recovery questionnaire. We received the initial pack but need further detail on your cross-region activation scenarios and how you verify state consistency after failover. Attached is a short spreadsheet (Meridian_DR_Q_v2.xlsx) with numbered questions — please review rows 12-24 which focus on multi-region activation, RPO/RTO guarantees, and post-failover verification steps.

Key asks:
- For each activation type (planned switchover, unplanned failover, partial-region outage), what is the expected RTO and RPO?
- How do you guarantee KV-cache and in-flight session consistency across regions?
- What evidence can you provide that a playbook executed successfully (logs, rehearsals, timestamps)?

Can you return a response and any supporting artifacts by EOD Friday? We need to include this in our vendor resilience review next week.

Thanks,
Laura Miles
Director, IT Resilience
Meridian Bank

Attachment: Meridian_DR_Q_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Laura Miles <security@meridianbank.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Meridian DR questionnaire - cross-region activation scenarios

Hi Laura —

Thanks for the clear spreadsheet; we've reviewed rows 12-24. I'm looping in Neha (account lead), Priyom (SRE lead), and Vivek (platform) so you have both product and operational context. Below are concise answers to the three bullets you called out. We'll follow up with a short appendix (Redwood_DR_Evidence.pdf) that contains rehearsal logs, runbook excerpts, and a link to a recorded playbook run.

Summary answers (high level):
- Planned switchover (self-initiated): Target RTO = 10 minutes for control-plane routing; RPO = 0-30s typical depending on customer topology. We use synchronous metadata replication for control-plane; customer data plane options vary (see notes).
- Unplanned failover (region outage): Target RTO = 2 minutes for automated routing to warm replicas; RPO = up to 60s conservative for most models — reduced to near-zero when using our KV prefix persist/copy option.
- Partial-region outage (service siloed): Target RTO = <5 minutes for degraded routing with prioritized traffic shaping; RPO = design-dependent, we provide clear tiering and recommended configs.

Operational controls and consistency guarantees:
- KV cache durability: we persist operation logs and maintain write-ahead prefix checkpoints to object storage, then rehydrate secondary region caches on activation. For low-RPO customers we offer synchronous replicate-to-secondary mode.
- In-flight sessions: short-lived tokens and session replay queues are drained to durable queues; clients are advised to rehydrate session state on reconnect (we provide client SDK helpers).
- Verification: playbook produces structured evidence: orchestration timeline, per-node health snapshots, applied routing table, and token-consumption metrics. See attached Redwood_DR_Evidence.pdf.

We'll prepare a more detailed appendix with explicit step-by-step activation sequences, exact metric thresholds, and example rehearsal logs. Is Meridian expecting quantified SLO-backed commitments in the contract, or are you collecting capability descriptions for procurement scoring? That will determine how prescriptive we should be.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Product Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_DR_Evidence.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)
From: Laura Miles <security@meridianbank.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@meridianbank.com
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Meridian DR questionnaire - cross-region activation scenarios

Irene — thanks for the quick summary and the evidence pack. A couple follow-ups from our resilience reviewers:

1) You mention a 60s RPO for unplanned failover unless synchronous replicate-to-secondary is enabled. For a high-volume production customer, can Redwood commit to a 30s RPO as a contractual option (we understand there may be a premium)? Please specify which configuration and cost-tier that requires.

2) For the KV cache rehydration workflow, can you provide an example timeline from failure detection to KV availability in the secondary region (timestamps and checkpoints)? Our reviewers want a concrete rehearsal log sample.

3) We also need clarity on data residency enforcement during failover — are there controls to prevent routing to a non-approved region for an account?

Would it be possible to get the explicit rehearsal log snippet and a short cost note by tomorrow morning? Procurement is preparing a resilience annex and would like to include the options.

Thanks — Laura
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Laura Miles <security@meridianbank.com>, irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 16:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Meridian DR questionnaire - cross-region activation scenarios

Laura —

Appreciate the follow-ups. I'm Priyom (SRE lead) — sending concrete details below and attaching a short rehearsal snippet and cost notes in-line. Let me know if you want us to map these into the procurement annex language.

1) 30s RPO contractual option:
- Configuration: enable synchronous replicate-to-secondary for control-plane + enable persistent KV prefix replication with immediate durable checkpointing. This requires Dedicated or Private deployment with cross-region replication enabled.
- Commitment: we can offer an optional RPO SLA = 30s (per-tenant) with an availability and throughput eligibility check. This is part of a paid resilience add-on (monthly fee + modest per-GB replication charge).

2) Example KV rehydration timeline (rehearsal snippet):
- 2026-08-12T14:01:12Z — health checker detects primary region failure (pod-level loss).
- 2026-08-12T14:01:15Z — control-plane issues route-shift request to secondary region.
- 2026-08-12T14:01:18Z — write-ahead prefix checkpoint synced to durable store (checkpoint ts=2026-08-12T14:01:17Z).
- 2026-08-12T14:01:21Z — KV rehydration job starts on secondary; streaming replay resumes at checkpoint ts.
- 2026-08-12T14:01:39Z — KV cache at 95% warmed; first consistent responses served from secondary.
- 2026-08-12T14:01:45Z — orchestration reports all health checks green and mark activation complete.
Observed RPO in this run: 28s. Full rehearsal log excerpt attached in Redwood_DR_Evidence.pdf (pages 3-4).

3) Data residency enforcement:
- Per-account region allowlist: routing policies are policy-driven and immutable during activation; accounts with residency constraints are blocked from routing to disallowed regions. Enforcement is at both control-plane (policy engine) and data-plane (region tag checks). During automated failover we only target pre-authorized secondary regions.

Attachments included: rehearsal_log_excerpt.txt (excerpt from playbook run), resilience_pricing_note.md.

Next steps:
- If you want the 30s RPO SLA priced and drafted into an annex, we can produce a redline for your legal team by Tuesday.
- Happy to run a joint rehearsal with Meridian engineers and provide raw logs for your audit team.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachment: rehearsal_log_excerpt.txt (text, 8KB); resilience_pricing_note.md (text, 4KB)
